SELECT kb.id, kb.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM document d WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id) AS document_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM document d WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id AND d.status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_base_role_grant g WHERE g.knowledge_base_id = kb.id) AS role_grant_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_base_member m WHERE m.knowledge_base_id = kb.id) AS member_count FROM knowledge_base kb
ORDER BY kb.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.knowledge_base_id, d.filename, d.media_type, d.sha256, d.size_bytes, d.status, d.error, d.chunk_count, d.created_at, d.replaces_document_id, old.filename AS replaces_filename FROM document d LEFT JOIN document old ON old.id = d.replaces_document_id
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
